title: Glasses with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Left lens -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='45' r='18' fill='#1a3a5c' stroke='#66ccff' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- Right lens -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='45' r='18' fill='#1a3a5c' stroke='#66ccff' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- Bridge -->
  <rect x='44' y='41' width='12' height='8' rx='3' fill='#66ccff'/>
  <!-- Left temple arm -->
  <rect x='8' y='38' width='8' height='6' rx='2' fill='#66ccff'/>
  <!-- Right temple arm -->
  <rect x='84' y='38' width='8' height='6' rx='2' fill='#66ccff'/>
  <!-- Left eye -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='42' r='3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Right eye -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='42' r='3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Smile in left lens -->
  <path d='M 20 50 Q 30 60 40 50' fill='none' stroke='#ff99cc' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Smile in right lens -->
  <path d='M 60 50 Q 70 60 80 50' fill='none' stroke='#ff99cc' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Blush left -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='50' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff6699' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Blush right -->
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='50' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff6699' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
